shots.phrase: Begin by framing Course Structure Overview as a question about inputs, decisions, and observable results.
Consider this worked case: A student might choose 'Machine Learning in Healthcare' for the survey thread and 'Developing a Low-Cost IoT Sensor Network' for the independent thread.
List the givens before choosing a method, because an unstated assumption can change the conclusion.
Now define Survey Paper Requirements precisely enough that another learner could test the definition.
Consider this worked case: Students will curate five recent ACM SIGCOMM papers on secure messaging protocols and synthesize their methodologies into a comparative analysis.
Separate the formal definition from an implementation detail, then identify what evidence would distinguish them.
With the foundation in place, examine how Independent Project Workflow operates in a concrete sequence.
Consider this worked case: A student developing a natural language processing tool will submit a one-page weekly milestone document detailing progress, obstacles, and next steps.
Follow every arrow in order and name the state before and after each transition.
Next, compare the choices involved in Final Deliverables and make the decision criteria explicit.

Consider this worked case: The survey paper culminates in a 15-page manuscript with an abstract, while the independent project ends with a 10-page technical report and a 10-minute defense presentation.
Compare alternatives against the same constraints so the evaluation does not move the goalposts.
Apply Admission Requirements to a worked situation instead of treating it as an isolated definition.

Consider this worked case: Students must submit a proposal outlining their chosen research topics and a brief statement of how the course aligns with their degree requirements before registration opens.
Work from the concrete inputs to the result, checking units, types, or invariants at each step.
Examine the tradeoffs in Ethical Computing Standards, including what improves and what becomes more difficult.
Consider this worked case: When analyzing datasets for the independent project, students must anonymize participant information and explicitly state how data privacy was maintained.
State the benefit, the cost, and the condition under which the tradeoff is acceptable.
Stress-test the reasoning around Research Integrity Practices with an edge case and identify which assumption controls the outcome.
Consider this worked case: Students will use reference managers to track citations, ensuring every methodological step and data source is properly attributed in the final report.
Change one assumption at a time and observe which part of the reasoning no longer holds.
Use Methodological Rigor to diagnose a failure by separating symptoms, causes, and corrective action.
Consider this worked case: When documenting the independent project's algorithm, students will include pseudocode, parameter settings, and baseline comparisons to enable independent verification.
Locate the first point where observed behavior diverges from expected behavior, then test the smallest plausible cause.
Connect Stakeholder & Impact Analysis to the earlier ideas and explain how the pieces work as one system.
Consider this worked case: Students will draft a brief stakeholder impact matrix for their independent project, mapping how their system might affect users, developers, and regulatory bodies.
Explain each connection explicitly and verify that information retains the same meaning across representations.
Finish with Practical Analysis Checklist as a practical checklist that can guide a new analysis.
Consider this worked case: A learner maps the inputs, constraints, and observable result for Practical Analysis Checklist, then checks each step against the stated claim.
For each checklist item, record the evidence, the remaining uncertainty, and the next verification step.
